t: You are looking at Caroline Gardens, the former almshouses of the Licensed Victuallers' Benevolent Institution, south of the Old Kent Road in Peckham. The buildings are Grade II listed. The bare-knuckle prize fighter Owen Swift died here in 1879. In 1838 a savage eighty-five round bout ended in the death of Brighton Bill, and Swift was convicted of manslaughter. That case led to the adoption of the London Prize Ring Rules.
